description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget called CategoryPieChart that renders a pie chart with labels and legends based on a list of slices. It uses CustomPainter to draw the pie chart and constructs UI elements such as legends, labels, and colors for each slice.

classes.name: CategoryPieChart
classes.description: A widget that displays a pie chart with legends, representing categories with slices.

classes.name: _PiePainter
classes.description: A CustomPainter responsible for rendering the pie slices based on the data.

classes.name: _LegendItem
classes.description: A widget that displays a color box and label for each slice in the legend.

methods.name: _colorForIndex
methods.description: Generates a color for a slice based on its index and theme colors.

methods.name: paint
methods.description: Paints the pie chart slices on the canvas.

methods.name: shouldRepaint
methods.description: Determines whether the painter needs to repaint based on slice data changes.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the CategoryPieChart, including the pie and legend layout.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget for each legend item.
